summary.decisions: Fields default to inert values so the existing straight-flight thorn path is byte-identical in behavior. summary.lessons_learned: Previous attempt likely burned budget exploring before editing; the plan snippet was empty and the 'bounce' acceptance criterion maps to the ballistic primitive's solidBehavior='reflect' mapping, not a new physics method — reading ballistic.js once resolved the ambiguity. Pool.spawn() deletes ALL entity keys before re-initialize, so new fields must be set in initialize(), never only at spawn time.
